purpose: Integrate declared dimensional requirements into preparation and automatic final inspection of normal FreeCAD/CAMotics jobs.
scope: Optional versioned inspection declaration in process input; preserve legacy plans when absent
Check original CAD, datum, provenance, criterion and available numerical resolution before native execution
Carry requirements binding through the execution plan and re-check it after native CAM
Use unchanged planar dimension kernel on actual final NC mesh automatically

resource_limits: Existing one-heavy-job, one CPU, 2 GiB, native 60s limits unchanged
qualification: New-input rejection and old execution-plan equivalence
Fresh complete small jobs with unchanged optional-dimension kernel
Actual measured dimension failures remain distinguishable from execution completion
Compare actual output geometry/IoU and expose declared input, prepared output and inspection evidence on webpage
